data.narrative:
QuantumScape is a public-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Jagdeep Singh, Tim Holme, and Fritz Prinz. The company currently trades at a $3.63B valuation after raising $2B+. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Enovix ($1.0B), Solid Power ($504M), and LanzaTech ($73M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across the three comps is $504M, with a range spanning $73M at the low end and $1.0B at the high end. This method reflects pricing dynamics within the public Climate & Energy technology space where QuantumScape competes.

The triangulated valuation range derived from this single method is $428M to $580M, anchored at a median of $504M. QuantumScape's current market valuation of $3.63B sits substantially above this peer-median benchmark—approximately 7.2x the derived median. The gap warrants scrutiny around whether market pricing reflects differentiated technology, IP position, or commercialization timeline relative to the comp set, or whether it reflects a valuation premium that may not be sustained. The limited methodological depth (single triangulation method) and the wide dispersion in comparable valuations ($73M to $1.0B) constitute material uncertainties in this assessment.
